purpose: Freeze the complete current production identities needed to decide a later cleanup-only lease. This request is not a cleanup or deployment lease.

requestedExecution.sshContract: Central must freeze the exact protected existing identity reference, host-key policy, target host and full literal SSH argv. Inspector bytes are sent only on stdin. No shell interpolation and no remote temporary path.

requiredOutput.current: exact symlink tuple, target and dereferenced old-release tuple
requiredOutput.service: LoadState, ActiveState, SubState, MainPID, NRestarts, FragmentPath, WorkingDirectory and User
requiredOutput.listeners: unique PIDs for 6493 API, 6494 Viewer and 6495 Creator
requiredOutput.receipt: exact tuple, bytes, SHA256, status, candidate SHA and before-current target
requiredOutput.candidate: exact root tuple, complete sorted directory and file inventory, and every child dev/inode/uid/gid/mode/nlink/type/bytes/SHA256 tuple
requiredOutput.candidateManifest: tuple, bytes, SHA256, source commit/tree and exactly 12 payload files
requiredOutput.control: exact root tuple, complete sorted directory and file inventory, and every child dev/inode/uid/gid/mode/nlink/type/bytes/SHA256 tuple
requiredOutput.placementReceipt: exact tuple, bytes, SHA256, status and exact root
requiredOutput.parents: exact parent tuples for receipt, candidate and control
requiredOutput.absence: current.next, receipt.next, candidate.next, control.next and every pre/post-switch quarantine
requiredOutput.public: status, bytes, SHA256, content-type and cache-control for root, app.js, manifest, i18n.js and catalog

forbidden: deploy, current switch, rollback or service restart
unit, Caddy, API, Viewer or public mutation
Wallet account request, signature, typed data or transaction
terminalRule: Return the complete canonical inspector JSON or one read-only blocker, then atomically release this read-only lease. A separate Central review is required before any cleanup-only lease may be issued.
